name: Story clip — dialogue scene (rig, Thai VO)

structure.panels: insert or ECU on the key detail

notes: floor plan per location; 180° line marked
definition: Board/plan template: Story clip — dialogue scene (rig, Thai VO). Panels follow 'structure'; every panel fills 'panel_fields' (the 20 DECISION_ENGINE fields + extras).
how: Copy templates/STORYBOARD_TEMPLATE.md (panels) or templates/SHOT_LIST_TEMPLATE.md (table); one panel per structure row; time panels from VO/beat data; validate with tools/check_scene.py.
purpose: Decide shots, timing and sound before spending render time or generation quota.
emotional_effect: indirect — controls pacing and intensity curve (Block contrast/affinity)
avoid_when: a skill with its own fixed template covers the job (beat-clip, eye-break-clip)
ai_image_prompt: rough storyboard panel, pencil sketch, correct aspect frame with safe zone, one idea per panel, movement arrows, no text
ai_video_prompt: one prompt per shot-list row: shot size + one action + one camera move + duration
common_mistakes: more than one idea per panel
check: Animatic length = VO length ±0.2 s; every panel has why + visual focus; no unintended 180° crossing.
